budget_items.topic: Ambulance fee abatement (deceased resident, no estate)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Uncollectable ambulance fee balance for a deceased resident with no estate was presented for abatement; the minutes print no dollar amount.
budget_items.quote: kerry presented the attached request from the fire chief as the resident is deceased and leaves no estate that we are able to collect from.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Warrant #49 11 dated 3/8/11 was reviewed and signed.

budget_items.topic: School budget gap between Superintendent and Town Manager budgets
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The School Committee's budget gap with the Town Manager's budget was described; the board was told it will not be made a burden on the town side.
budget_items.quote: will not make the $600,000 gap between the superintendent's budget and town manger's budget a burden on the town side of the budget.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Snow expenditures are about $25,000 over budget; state law allows the deficit to be carried and the town hopes to fund it through transfers from other departments this fiscal year.
budget_items.quote: also presented the attached snow expenditures to date;currently about $25,000 deficit.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Snow appropriation, expended and balance totals as of 3/3/11, with a deficit shown in parentheses; the table's line items were printed alongside.

budget_items.topic: Town Hall painting by work release crew
